success_definition.replanned_recovery: replanning recovery is reported separately and remains in primary denominator
success_definition.failure: any other outcome or incomplete audit

replanning_policy: A task that needs replanning is not counted as primary success; it remains in the denominator and is reported as replanned_recovery.

aggregation.high_risk_metric_note: not_applicable: frozen manifest has no no_fly_zone or crowd_surge task
aggregation.aggregation_formula: count(outcome == success AND audit_complete == true) / eligible_task_count; replanned_recovery remains in denominator and is recovery-only
